final_runtime_execution.method: All 100 original font PDFs were reconverted after installing the final clipping repair. The installed runtime remained frozen for every conversion and the subsequent original-font coordinate audit; source/installed bytes and all saved DXF hashes were rechecked afterwards.

limitations: These 84 short and 16 long generated PDFs are known-font test fixtures, not a representative universal-font benchmark.
Legacy v1/v2 catalogs remain readable but cannot supply v3 layout measurements.
Runtime uses saved DXF geometry and verified catalogs only; no OCR or original font/PDF access for outline recognition.
Unicode coverage is unchanged, derived from unchanged verified cmap/template rows and the pinned Unicode 17 reference. IVS and arbitrary font variants remain unsupported.
